zh-CN.shortDesc: 上游 in-progress（测试中）技能，仅在用户显式手动调用时运行：在单个长会话中作为统筹者，把工作分派给后台子 Agent，在与用户约定的文件夹中维护注明日期的 Markdown 知识库，并在宿主支持时建议定期计划，持续推进长期目标；需要宿主支持子 Agent。

en-US.shortDesc: Upstream in-progress skill that runs only when the user invokes it explicitly: acts as a chief of staff in one long session, delegating work to background subagents, keeping a dated Markdown wiki in a folder agreed with the user and suggesting recurring schedules where the host supports them; requires host subagent support.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 按规格和任务依赖图实现功能；需要宿主支持子 Agent、Git 分支及所选任务跟踪工具。

en-US.shortDesc: Implement a specification and its task graph; requires host subagents, Git branches and the chosen issue tracker.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 为拉取请求撰写说明，交代修改内容、验证证据和合并影响。

en-US.shortDesc: Write pull request descriptions covering changes, validation evidence and merge impact.

zh-CN.shortDesc: 回顾编程会话，依据日志与现有检查改进开发环境和工作规则。

en-US.shortDesc: Review a coding session using logs and existing checks to improve the development environment and working rules.
